title: Keep Follow up context E2E proof to integrated journeys

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#trim-follow-up-context-e2e-journeys at 9a7ab0410f567c7a878d34cb9e77191f83cfde4d

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path (bounded to the checks examined below).

Promise: a Follow up started from a line of a Done story's diff in Intent → Changes with "Attach story notes" checked sends the waiting notes (<line-notes>) with the line request; the deleted e2e/intent/intent-follow-up-notes.spec.ts exercised this path.

Fault: dashboard/src/followUpRequest.ts followUpSourceAttaching() changed `...(notes ? { notes: true } : {})` to `...(notes && source.story.file?.line === undefined ? { notes: true } : {})`, dropping notes only for line-anchored follow-ups.

Witness: the deleted spec's "selected session and notes with their own targets" case, recovered into a scratch worktree (note-detail steps removed because those page-object methods no longer exist), failed at `expect(input).toContain(notesSection)` with no <line-notes> in first input after the notes box was checked and the launch happened. Examined maintained checks stayed green under the fault: frontend follow-up-note-handoff and follow-up-session-choices (6), e2e recently-done-follow-up (2) and story-review-diff-line-follow-up (2). Backend follow-up launch specs post requests directly and cannot reach this page-side fault. Restoration verified: the same commands passed again and the scratch worktree was removed.

Omitted transition: Intent Changes diff line → Follow up → Attach story notes → Start → first input contains <line-notes>.
Next proof action: add proof for the omitted transition (cheapest: a frontend mount case for a line-anchored follow-up requesting notes: true).

Costs: test runtime about 88 s measured (vitest 4.91, 3.67, 3.86, 5.14 s; Playwright 24.2, 10.9, 24.6, 11.0 s), excluding npm ci; human effort unavailable (no human involvement measured); agent effort unavailable (about 13 tool calls, no token or time measure); invocation-to-report elapsed 179045 ms measured (1795520213150 → 1795520392195 Unix epoch ms).

Wrap-up disposition (checked revision 9a7ab0410f567c7a878d34cb9e77191f83cfde4d): the gap came from this story's own move of journey detail to lower-level tests, so it was repaired within the story rather than queued. Commit 40ab6abca adds "a line Follow up requests the selected notes with its reviewed line" to dashboard/frontend-tests/launches/follow-up-note-handoff.spec.ts, mounting the composer on a file + line anchor and expecting notes: true beside that line. The same scratch fault fails that case and the restored source passes it. No follow-up queued.
